Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a great midsize propane gas grill. The best one I've own so far. The two burners gets the temps up fast. The cast iron grill grates it comes with are perfect to sear and grill on. There is also a stainless steel grate that can sit over the cast iron grill grates to cook indirectly. Controlling the temp is easy, and most importantly, the temperature stays consistent throughout the grill. No hot and cold spots that I've noticed. I've been using this grill multiple times a week since I've got it. Cleaning the whole grill is easy. It comes with a removal tray for a drip pan under the grill. Overall, I highly recommend this grill. The Spirit II E-210 does what it's meant to do really well, and it easy to maintain.
Results.Title: Fantastic propane grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

44060001.Description: Open your door to the world of grilling with the sleek Spirit II E-210 gas grill. Welcome to the Weber family.
